rule: Every declared add-on function and managed module-main execution unit has a visible cycle ledger. Unknown historical add-on cost is symbolic, never zero.

atomic.notify.note: Wake cost depends on waiter/OS state.

runtime.call.subledger.note: Composition edge; resolved by target function ledger.

runtime.callback.note: Callback body resolved by supplied target ledger; call overhead remains profile-sensitive.

memory.allocate.shared.bytes.note: Shared backing-store allocation and zero initialization.

runtime.typed_array.allocate.note: TypedArray allocation; maps to NEES typed-array allocation family.

runtime.array.copy.note: Bulk copy cost remains locality and byte-count dependent.

runtime.managed_wait.note: Session wait may block with no finite elapsed upper bound.

runtime.managed_close.note: Worker terminate/join may block with no finite elapsed upper bound.

runtime.legacy.addon.body.note: Historical add-on body is explicitly unresolved/nonzero until decomposed; never treated as free.

runtime.array.allocate.note: JavaScript Array allocation; size and GC state dependent.

runtime.typed_array.fill.note: Bulk typed-array fill; byte count and locality dependent.

runtime.timer.read.note: High-resolution runtime timer read; implementation and runtime-state dependent.

runtime.url.construct.note: URL object construction and parsing are cold runtime work, not zero.

runtime.module.bookkeeping.note: Residual module-startup property loads/coercions/object assembly remain explicitly nonzero until further decomposed.

runtime.host.bookkeeping.note: Residual cold host validation/property/result assembly remains explicitly nonzero until further decomposed.

runtime.counter.load.note: Load of a JavaScript numeric counter field; source-to-machine representation is runtime/profile-sensitive.

runtime.metric.store.note: Generic metric-sink store; sink representation is caller-dependent.

memory.store.f64.note: Float64Array store; locality/ownership and source lowering remain profile-sensitive.

runtime.root.storage.setup.note: Root ingress temporary/result storage setup; allocation, slicing, and initialization remain runtime/size dependent.

runtime.move.validation.note: Per-move ingress validation/control work; retained symbolically until source-to-machine lowering is qualified.

runtime.evaluate.fixed.note: Fixed non-subledger evaluator work such as state-field loads/stores, dispatch tests, and loop/control bookkeeping; explicitly nonzero.

runtime.position_code.evaluate.note: Optional physical position-code child advancement/reflection/store work. Managed runtime selects this count to zero.

runtime.publish.dispatch.note: Result-code dispatch/control and argument selection before exact/surplus publication.

runtime.integer.check.note: JavaScript integer validation/coercion; source-to-machine lowering remains V8-sensitive.

runtime.field.load.note: JavaScript object/property numeric load; hidden-class and cache-state dependent.

runtime.field.store.note: JavaScript object/property numeric store; hidden-class and write-barrier state dependent.

memory.load.u8.note: Uint8Array load; locality and V8 lowering dependent.

memory.store.u8.note: Uint8Array store; locality and ownership state dependent.

alu.xor.u32.note: Zen-family scalar 32-bit XOR seed cost; requalify if V8 lowering changes.

alu.or.u32.note: Zen-family scalar 32-bit OR seed cost; requalify if V8 lowering changes.

alu.shl.u32.note: Zen-family scalar 32-bit left-shift seed cost; requalify if V8 lowering changes.

alu.shr.u32.note: Zen-family scalar 32-bit logical right-shift seed cost; requalify if V8 lowering changes.

runtime.instanceof.check.note: JavaScript instanceof/type check; V8 lowering and object shape dependent.

runtime.array.slice.note: Array slice allocation/copy cost; length and GC state dependent.

runtime.error.throw.note: JavaScript exception throw/unwind cost, including runtime and stack-state effects.

runtime.constructor.dispatch.note: JavaScript class constructor/super dispatch; allocation and field stores are accounted separately.
